name: Arraiján

queries.query: Arraiján Panama official cadastral map parcel viewer cadastre municipality
queries.result: Official discovery found the Municipality of Arraiján and an official 2016 municipal functions manual documenting a cadastral/GIS unit responsible for municipal cadastral information and parcel cartography. It also found the current MIVIOT Geoportal, but that portal is for territorial planning/zoning and did not evidence an Arraiján parcel layer.

queries.query: Arraiján Panamá catastro mapa catastral parcelas visor oficial municipio
queries.result: La búsqueda oficial/local identificó al Municipio de Arraiján como custodio municipal de información catastral y cartografía parcelaria. Panamá Digital identifica los servicios de puntos catastrales y aprobación de planos de ANATI, pero no se encontró un visor público anónimo con identidad nativa y geometría parcelaria para Arraiján.

researchNote: The Municipality of Arraiján is treated as a local cadastral custodian because the official municipal manual assigns cadastral/GIS and parcel-cartography functions within its jurisdiction. This packet records source discovery only; no parcel source was admitted and runtimeReadiness remains held.
